messages:
jess_marketing: FYI noticing reports of higher-than-normal embeddings latency in eu-west. need a quick comms plan for customers + status page. who has scope? :loudspeaker:

raul_ops: investigating. early sign it's related to a recent KV cache change causing bigger batch queues for text-embed-large. rolling back plan in motion. more details in ~10-15m.

leigh_support: we already have 4 tickets. i can load response snippets into Intercom and Zendesk. recommend doing a private notification to enterprise/Dedicated first.

tom_product: agree private-first. Suggested status wording (short):
```
Investigating elevated embeddings latency in eu-west affecting certain models. Engineers are reverting a recent runtime change and expect an update within 30 minutes. No data loss. Temporary workaround: route requests to eu-north or use "embed-lite" variants.
```

jess_marketing: good. timing proposal: 1) enterprise/Dedicated private email in 10m, 2) public status page post (Investigating) in 20m after region/model scope confirmed, 3) social post only after mitigation in staging. Also, put tomorrow's customer webinar on a 30-min incident agenda hold — we might open with 5-10m incident update.

nate_sales: please tag any accounts with active POC or demos; i'll handle outreach for top ARR. also need a short sales-facing note to send to AE Slack channel.

raul_ops: confirmed impacted: eu-west1 pools serving text-embed-large and text-embed-xxl; some Dedicated customers using heavy concurrent embedding batches. rollback started v soon; aiming for verification in 25-35m.

incident_bot: Incident INC-2026-0424 created ": Investigating embeddings latency (eu-west)" severity P2. Runbook: rollback -> staging perf check -> grad restore -> customer updates.

jess_marketing: draft private email copy, please edit: 
"Hi — we're investigating an embeddings performance issue in eu-west affecting some models. We're reverting a recent runtime change; no customer data affected. We'll update within 30 minutes and recommend routing mission-critical requests to eu-north or using embed-lite for now. — Redwood Support"

leigh_support: i'll drop that into snippets and include a short FAQ line: 
- "Will my data be affected?" -> "No evidence of data loss or corruption."
- "How long?" -> "We expect mitigation in ~30-45 minutes; we'll update sooner if we see progress."

jess_marketing: social draft for later (hold): "We're investigating elevated embeddings latency in eu-west; engineers are rolling back a recent change. We will post updates when service is verified. For critical workloads, try eu-north or embed-lite." keep it under 280 chars.

tom_product: also recommend adding a note to the model catalog pages for text-embed-* so customers searching see the advisory until resolved.

nate_sales: ping me once rollback verified. i'll reach out to top 15 accounts and flag any contracts that might be sensitive.

raul_ops: rollback done on one pool; preliminary staging metrics look promising (tail latency reduced ~40%). continuing verification across other pools. ETA for full restore ~20m.

jess_marketing: ok publish schedule: publish private email now (10m), publish status page 'Investigating' at +20m, and public tweet only once we confirm staged mitigation. i'll also update webinar invite to include a short incident update at start.

leigh_support: sending private emails & loading snippets now. adding an "ops contact" line for Enterprise customers (ops@redwood.com).

incident_bot: Incident INC-2026-0424 updated: rollback in progress; next update scheduled in 30 minutes.

jess_marketing: thanks all. will coordinate post-incident messaging follow-up (postmortem-friendly language + transparency on root cause). tagging: @raul_ops @leigh_support @nate_sales. :white_check_mark:
